Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF UNDERSECRETARY LOCAL GOVERNMENT 10 October 2006 MR. BRIAN KRISTIANN AMINTUAN BAVONA SK Chairman and SK City Federation Vice President Barangay 98, Zone 14, Pasay City Dear Mr. Bayona: This pertains to your letter requesting that you be officially appointed as Acting Ex-Officio Member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Pasay City in view of the preventive suspension for six (6) months imposed upon the City SK Federation President by the Office of the Ombudsman and being the incumbent SK City Federation Vice President of Pasay City In reply thereto, may you be apprised that there is no more need fo official appointment. Your assumption to office as temporary Ex-Offici Member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod is by operation of law and t Constitution and By Laws of the Sangguniang Kabataan Federation. Article VIII, Section 2 of the SK Constitution and By Laws provide that the Vice President is the next highest officer of the federation and a such, he/she shall, among others, discharge the functions of the President i case the latter dies, resigns, becomes physically incapacitated or i suspended or removed from office. Corollarily, Article X VI, Section 3 of the SK Constitution and By Law likewise provides that in case the President of the federation is suspended a a result of an administrative case, the Vice President shall automaticall assume the office of the federation president in an acting capacity until suc time that the president reassumes his office. Further, he shall discharge th powers and duties and enjoy the rights and privileges appurtenant to thf office including representation in the Sanggunian and the receipt of th corresponding monetary remuneration for the service rendered. On your position that the preventive suspension of the SK Federati President deems to include the position of SK Chairman, the same is w II taken. Some camps would argue that the preventive suspension of the President, having been charged together with the other members of t e Sangguniang Panlungsod, would only pertain to his being an Ex-Offic o Member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod. We are not persuaded. The preventive suspension of a public official shall encompass t e public office being held by the public official under preventive suspensio 6

-2- and that is, as SK Chairman. It is worth to note that his being an SK Chairman and later on elected as SK Federation President of Pasay City are the main reasons why he is there sitting as Ex-Officio Member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod. In relation to the foregoing, provisions of the SK Constitution and By Laws, may we note that under Section 438 of the Local Government Code, it is provided that an SK Chairman who has been elected as Federation President, shali serve as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod without need of further appointment. Considering that the SK Federation President is now under preventive suspension and that by applying the SK Constitution and By Laws, the Vice President shall automatically assume the Office of the SK Federation President in an acting capacity, such assumption would also entitle the SK Federation Vice President, now as Acting President of the SK Federation, to sit as Ex-Officio Member of the Sangguniang Paniungsod being the highest official of the SK Federation in that city. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Very truly yours, WENCELITO T.
